result.summary: 本文提出了“精度感知”的缩放定律，用于预测语言模型在低精度训练和后训练量化下的损失 [abstract]。作者提出低精度训练会降低模型的有效参数量，并据此预测训练和量化带来的额外损失 [abstract]。对于推理，后训练量化带来的退化随训练数据增加而增大，最终使额外的预训练数据变得有害 [abstract]。作者在超过 465 次预训练运行上拟合，并在高达 1.7B 参数、26B token 的模型上验证了预测 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的核心问题是：精度、参数量和数据量之间存在怎样的权衡，以及这些权衡在预训练和推理时有何不同 [S1.p1]。作者指出，精度是影响成本和性能的第三个重要因素，但当前的缩放定律并未考虑这一点 [S1.p1]。研究动机在于深度学习正趋向更低精度，如 Llama-3 系列使用 BF16 训练，且业界正努力将预训练范式推向 FP8 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, the precision in which models are trained and served is an important third factor that contributes to both cost and performance.
Specifically, we ask: What are the tradeoffs between precision, parameters, and data? How do they compare for pretraining and inference?
current frontier models like the Llama-3 series are trained in BF16, and there is widespread effort to move the pretraining paradigm to FP8.

method.text: 论文提出用“有效参数量” N_eff 来统一建模精度与参数量的权衡，即比特精度和参数量可互换地贡献于有效参数量 [S1.p2]。对于训练，作者将 Chinchilla 缩放定律中的 N 替换为 N_eff(N, P_w) = N(1 - e^{-P_w/γ_w})，并进一步将权重、激活和 KV 缓存的量化效应建模为独立且可乘的 [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS2.p5]。对于后训练量化，作者将退化建模为随 token/参数比 D/N 增长的幂律，并乘以随量化精度指数衰减的项 [S3.SS1.p1]。最终，作者将训练和推理的缩放定律统一为单一函数形式，同时包含训练时效应和后训练量化效应 [S5.p8]。

evidence.quote: This functional form that posits bit precision and parameter count interchangeably contribute to a model’s “effective parameter count,” $N_{\text{eff}}$
we find the best fit for the tradeoff between weight precision and parameters is $N_{\text{eff}}(N,P_{\text{w}})=N(1-e^{-P_{\text{w}}/\gamma_{\text{w}}})$
The effects of quantizing the weights, activations, and KV cache during training are well modeled as independent and multiplicative
$\delta_{\text{PTQ}}(N,D,P_{\text{post}})=C_{T}\left(\frac{D^{\gamma_{D}}}{N^{\gamma_{N}}}\right)e^{-P_{\text{post}}/\gamma_{\text{post}}}$

the predicted loss for a language model with $N$ parameters, trained on $D$ tokens, with training precision $P_{\text{w}},P_{\text{a}},P_{\text{kv}}$ to end-time weight-precision $P_{\text{post}}$, can be predicted as $L(N,D,P_{\text{w}},P_{\text{a}},P_{\text{kv}},P_{\text{post}})=AN_{\text{eff}}^{-\alpha}+BD^{-\beta}+E+\delta_{\text{PTQ}}$

experiments.text: 作者在 Dolma V1.7 数据集上训练和评估了一系列 OLMo 风格的模型，使用标准 Transformer++ 实现 [S2.SS3.p1]。实验扫描了 N ∈ [30, 60, 110, 220] 百万参数（非嵌入）和 D ∈ [1.5, 3, 6, 13, 26] 十亿 token，并对每个 (N, D) 组合启动超过 20 次运行，扫描 8 个精度值 [S2.SS3.p1]。作者在超过 465 次预训练运行上拟合，并在高达 1.7B 参数、26B token 的模型上验证预测 [abstract]。此外，作者还使用 AWQ 和 round-to-nearest 量化方法复现了后训练量化的缩放结果 [A6.p1]。

evidence.quote: We train and evaluate a suite of OLMo-style models on the Dolma V1.7 dataset, using a standard Transformer++ implementation
Our experiments consist of a sweep of language model pretraining runs over $N\in[30,60,110,220]$ million parameters (non-embedding) and $D\in[1.5,3,6,13,26]$ billion tokens.
we train up to a very high $D/N\approx 10^{3}$ to study data scaling and set off over 20 runs at every $(N,D)$: we sweep 8 values of precision
We fit on over 465 pretraining runs and validate our predictions on model sizes up to 1.7B parameters trained on up to 26B tokens.
We replicate on AWQ and round-to-nearest quantization.

findings.text: 后训练量化的损失退化随训练数据量增加而增大，对于固定模型，当 D/N 足够大或量化精度足够低时，额外的预训练数据可能反而增加量化后的损失 [S3.SS1.p3]。训练时量化权重、激活和 KV 缓存的效果可建模为独立且可乘的，统一为有效参数量 N_eff [S4.SS2.p5]。当联合优化 N、D、P 时，计算最优的预训练精度与计算预算无关，拟合结果约为 7-8 比特 [S4.SS3.SSS2.p1]。当模型大小 N 固定时，计算最优精度随计算预算对数增长，即 P*(C) ∝ log C [S4.SS3.SSS3.p2]。统一缩放定律在超过 1000 个数据点上拟合得到 R² = 0.90 [S5.p6]。

evidence.quote: This implies that when $D/N$ is sufficiently large, or $P_{\text{post}}$ sufficiently small, loss after quantization can increase as models are pretrained for longer
The effects of quantizing the weights, activations, and KV cache during training are well modeled as independent and multiplicative
which reveals that in general the optimal pretraining precision is independent of compute budget.
We find this $P^{*}$ to be around 7-8 bits when fitting our scaling law on runs with quantization done to integer type.
when $N$ is fixed in advance, such as when training a model family on similar data, $P^{*}(C)\propto\log C$
we find a strong fit with $R^{2}=0.90$ on over 1000 data points

limitations.text: 作者承认，研究全程使用固定架构来受控地考察精度、参数量和 token 的影响，而低精度训练通常涉及架构调整，这些调整可以缩小与普通全精度模型的大部分差距 [S6.p2]。其次，虽然计算成本确实随精度线性缩放，但由于系统开销，将精度减半带来的收益通常不到 2 倍 [S6.p2]。第三，作者只考虑了损失缩放，没有进行下游模型评估 [S6.p2]。作者强调所发现的趋势旨在提供启示而非规定性结论，并希望未来工作能在更大模型规模上更全面地检验这些效应 [S6.p2]。

evidence.quote: First, we use a fixed architecture throughout to examine the effects of precision, parameters, and tokens in a controlled manner.
In contrast, low precision training often involves architectural tweaks that can close much of the gap from a vanilla full precision model.
Second, while compute costs do scale linearly with precision, the gains from halving precision are usually less than 2x due to systems overhead.
Third, we only consider loss scaling without downstream model evaluations.
We emphasize that the trends we find aim to be suggestive rather than prescriptive, and hope future work can more comprehensively examine these effects at larger model scale.
